bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
ci_package=44838974338
ci_profile=44838974493
source=641e5b8b599a6457dddfccf256c9316d9c361d0a
test "$(gh run view "$ci_package" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "$source success" || exit 60
test "$(gh run view "$ci_profile" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "$source success" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 62
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-five-5598)" || exit 63
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 64
docker logs --tail 200 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 65
before="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||':'||thread_id||':'||message_id||':'||owner_user_id||':'||synced_revision FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0 ORDER BY chat_id,thread_id,message_id;")" || exit 66
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$before" | wc -l)" -eq 7 || exit 67
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-profile-backfill.XXXXXXXX)"
remote_file=/tmp/gace-profile-backfill-once.mjs
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 docker exec --user root deploy-gaybbs-1 rm -f "$remote_file" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
gh run download "$ci_package" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 68
test -s "$tmp/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs" || exit 69
docker run --rm --network none -v "$tmp:/bundle:ro" --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-five-5598 --check /bundle/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs >/dev/null || exit 70
docker cp "$tmp/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs" "deploy-gaybbs-1:$remote_file" || exit 71
dry="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs "$remote_file" --dry-run)" || exit 72
printf '%s\n' "$dry"
printf '%s\n' "$dry" | grep -Fq '"existing_posts":7' || exit 73
printf '%s\n' "$dry" | grep -Fq '"applied":0' || exit 74
printf '%s\n' "$dry" | grep -Fq '"uncertain":0' || exit 75
echo PROFILE_DRY_RUN=PASS
if applied="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs "$remote_file" --apply)";then
 printf '%s\n' "$applied"
else
 echo PROFILE_BACKFILL_PARTIAL_OR_FAILED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED
 exit 76
fi
printf '%s\n' "$applied" | grep -Fq '"existing_posts":7' || exit 77
printf '%s\n' "$applied" | grep -Fq '"applied":7' || exit 78
printf '%s\n' "$applied" | grep -Fq '"uncertain":0' || exit 79
after="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||':'||thread_id||':'||message_id||':'||owner_user_id||':'||synced_revision FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0 ORDER BY chat_id,thread_id,message_id;")" || exit 80
test "$before" = "$after" || exit 81
counts="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT state||'='||count(*) FROM profile_keyboard_backfill GROUP BY state ORDER BY state;")" || exit 82
printf '%s\n' "$counts"
test "$counts" = 'applied=7' || exit 83
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 84
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 85
echo PROFILE_EXISTING_SEVEN_MARKUP_UPDATED=PASS
echo PROFILE_ORIGINAL_MESSAGE_IDS_UNCHANGED=PASS
echo PROFILE_REPOSTS_OR_DELETIONS=NONE
echo PROFILE_COMMON_BOT_RUNNING=PASS
